summary.business_type: Travel/Tourism — Informational guide for international visitors to Beijing
top_findings: No robots.txt or XML sitemap — zero crawl guidance for search engines
All 10 attraction images are SVG placeholders (dark rectangles with text), not real photos
No WebSite or Organization schema on homepage
Empty blog page linked from main navigation
No E-E-A-T authority signals: no author info, citations, or update dates on subpages
quick_wins: Add WebSite + Organization JSON-LD to BaseLayout
Add FAQPage schema to FAQ page

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean static site architecture with pre-rendered HTML
All pages have valid canonical URLs
Proper HTTP status codes (200/404) across all routes
SSL/HTTPS configured, no mixed content
Responsive viewport meta and charset declarations

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.description: Site returns 404 for /robots.txt. Search engines have no crawl instructions or sitemap pointer.
findings.recommendation: Create public/robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.xml.

findings.title: No XML sitemap
findings.description: Site returns 404 for /sitemap.xml. Dynamic routes like /attractions/[slug] and /type/[type] may not be discovered.
findings.recommendation: Install @astrojs/sitemap and configure in astro.config.mjs.

findings.title: Empty /type/culture route
findings.description: The 'culture' type is defined but has zero attractions, creating a 302 redirect dead-end.
findings.recommendation: Filter getStaticPaths to only generate pages for types with attractions.

findings.title: Missing OG image
findings.description: All pages reference /images/og-default.jpg which does not exist on disk.
findings.recommendation: Create a 1200x630px branded OG image.

findings.title: HTML entities in titles
findings.description: Titles render & instead of & in raw HTML source.
findings.recommendation: Review Astro template literal encoding for title strings.

findings.title: No custom 404 page
findings.description: 404 responses return a basic dev error page.
findings.recommendation: Create src/pages/404.astro with navigation links.

findings.title: Inline CSS in dev mode
findings.description: 71KB CSS inlined per page in dev. Production extracts to separate file.
findings.recommendation: Review Tailwind purge config to reduce production CSS.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Attraction descriptions are specific, informative, and show real domain knowledge
Homepage FAQ and pre-trip checklist are genuinely useful and not generic filler
Content is written in clear, fluent English for international travelers
Information density is good: ticket prices, subway exits, booking procedures

findings.title: Empty blog page
findings.description: The /blog page is a dead-end with only 'Coming soon' text but is linked from the main navigation.
findings.recommendation: Publish 3-5 blog posts or remove the blog link until content is ready.

findings.title: Thin About page
findings.description: About page has only 150 words with no author credentials or editorial process.
findings.recommendation: Expand to include author expertise, methodology, and update policy.

findings.title: No author attribution
findings.description: Zero E-E-A-T signals: no author names, credentials, or organizational transparency.
findings.recommendation: Add author/editor bylines and Organization schema.

findings.title: No external citations
findings.description: The entire site has zero external links. No references to UNESCO, official sites, or primary sources.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 external citations per attraction page.

findings.title: Boilerplate visitor tips
findings.description: Three tip items on every attraction page are nearly identical.
findings.recommendation: Make at least 1 tip per page attraction-specific.

findings.title: Inflated attraction count
findings.description: Homepage claims '50+ attractions' but only 10 are listed.
findings.recommendation: Expand data or adjust homepage copy.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All pages have unique, keyword-rich title tags and meta descriptions
Clean, descriptive URLs with hyphens (e.g., /attractions/forbidden-city)
Strong internal linking: 57 links across 22 unique targets on homepage
H1 headings present on every page and match page topic

findings.title: Heading hierarchy gaps
findings.description: Multiple subpages jump from H1 to H4 with no H2/H3 section headings.
findings.recommendation: Add H2 headings to break all pages into scannable content sections.

findings.title: Missing breadcrumbs on subpages
findings.description: Only attraction detail pages have breadcrumb navigation.
findings.recommendation: Add breadcrumbs to type, collection, and compare pages.

findings.title: Non-functional mobile menu
findings.description: The hamburger button has no associated menu panel or JS toggle.
findings.recommendation: Implement a working mobile navigation with all 4 nav links.

findings.title: Inconsistent title conventions
findings.description: Some titles include [2026] suffix, others do not.
findings.recommendation: Standardize: either add year to all or remove from all.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Attraction detail pages have valid TouristAttraction JSON-LD
Schema includes name, description, address, and touristType
JSON-LD is well-formed on all 10 attraction pages

findings.title: No WebSite or Organization schema
findings.description: Homepage lacks the most fundamental schema types.
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite + Organization JSON-LD to BaseLayout.astro.

findings.title: Minimal TouristAttraction properties
findings.description: Only 4-5 properties used. Missing: image, url, geo, offers, openingHours.
findings.recommendation: Expand schema to include all available attraction data.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList schema
findings.description: Visual breadcrumbs exist but no structured data.
findings.recommendation: Generate BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on pages with breadcrumb navigation.

findings.title: No FAQPage schema
findings.description: FAQ pages use details elements but lack FAQPage JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema to FAQ page and homepage FAQ section.

findings.title: No ItemList on list pages
findings.description: Type pages and collections page list attractions but lack ItemList schema.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList schema to listing pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static site generation — zero client-side JavaScript required
No third-party scripts, analytics, or ad networks
Self-hosted fonts in modern woff2 format
CSS aspect-ratio containers prevent layout shift
Images use loading=lazy and decoding=async

findings.title: CSS bundle size
findings.description: Production CSS is 71KB. Tailwind purge likely leaving unused utilities.
findings.recommendation: Review Tailwind content paths and purge configuration.

findings.title: Font payload
findings.description: 150KB of font files for Latin subfamily across 6 weights.
findings.recommendation: Add font-display:swap and evaluate if all weights are needed.

findings.title: No asset preloading
findings.description: Critical fonts and hero image are not preloaded.
findings.recommendation: Add link rel=preload for primary font files.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Content is structured in clear sections with descriptive headings
JSON-LD schema on attraction pages provides machine-readable data
All content is in static HTML — no JS-dependent information
Content demonstrates first-hand domain knowledge

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: Missing the emerging standard for LLM-friendly site summaries.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt with site overview and key page links.

findings.title: No E-E-A-T authority signals
findings.description: No author credentials, no citations, no organizational transparency.
findings.recommendation: Add author info, external references, and update dates to every page.

findings.title: Thin entity coverage
findings.description: Attraction pages lack hours, geo coordinates, accessibility, and nearby info that AI models extract.
findings.recommendation: Expand entity data on all attraction pages.

findings.title: No multilingual content
findings.description: English-only despite Beijing attracting visitors from many language groups.
findings.recommendation: Consider Chinese-language pages for the largest addressable audience.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text is present on all images
Images use lazy loading and async decoding
Aspect-ratio containers prevent CLS

findings.title: All images are SVG placeholders
findings.description: Every attraction 'photo' is a dark rectangle with text — no real photographs anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Replace all 10 images with real photographs (800x450px, WebP).

findings.title: File extension mismatch
findings.description: Files named .jpg contain SVG markup, which is technically invalid.
findings.recommendation: Rename or replace files with correct extensions.

findings.title: No responsive images
findings.description: Single src with no srcset — all viewports get the same 800x450 image.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset or use Astro Image component.

findings.title: Missing width/height attributes
findings.description: No explicit dimensions on img tags, which affects LCP scoring.
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes to all images.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Create robots.txt with sitemap reference
Install @astrojs/sitemap for auto-generated sitemap
Fix /type/culture empty route
Replace all 10 SVG placeholder images with real photos
Create branded OG image (1200x630)
Add WebSite + Organization JSON-LD to BaseLayout

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand About page with E-E-A-T content
Publish blog posts or remove blog from nav
Add external citations per attraction page
Add FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, and expanded schema
Fix heading hierarchy and add breadcrumbs on all pages
Implement working mobile navigation

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Create llms.txt for AI crawlers
Add update dates and author attribution to all pages
Expand attraction entities with hours, geo, accessibility
Expand to 50+ attractions or adjust homepage copy
Add ItemList and Article schema where applicable

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console and GA4
Monitor Core Web Vitals monthly
Track AI citation growth
Regular ticket/subway info updates
Consider Chinese-language i18n pages
